title: 第17章 北方资源第18章 农田蚯蚓
slug: 迷雾求生从流民开始的领主之路
content_zh:
四只腐尸鬼，二十点经验。
亚修杵着短矛站在枯树林边缘，呼吸平稳，看着视野中缓缓消散的幽蓝光幕。
腐尸鬼虽然看着狰狞。
但有了装备和技能加持，宰起来比那种灵活且成群结队的巨鼠要轻松得多，经验值却丰厚不少。
“唯一的缺点就是太穷。”
他在四具尸体里翻找了半天，只摸出了两枚指甲盖大小的晶石碎片。
亚修站起身，视线落在那个闪烁的【自由属性点】上。
他略一沉吟，视线掠过“体质”与“敏捷”，最终毫不犹豫地再次点在了“力量”上。
有了皮甲护身、圆盾格挡，容错率已经大幅提升。
在这个阶段，体力和敏捷的收益远不如极致的暴力输出直观——
比起防御和躲避，他先把对面的脑壳敲碎！
【力量：6→7】
嗡——
熟悉的暖流再次冲刷全身。
肌肉纤维在那股力量的灌注下疯狂震颤、收紧、重组！
亚修握了握拳。
空气在指掌间被捏爆，发出一声脆响。
皮甲下摆，原本平坦的小腹此刻线条分明，六块腹肌如岩石般隆起，蕴含着爆炸性的爆发力。
这不仅仅是数字的加一。
如果说6点力量，是常年健身的壮汉，能在工地上扛起百斤水泥。

那7点力量，就是……
那么现在的7点，就是职业举重运动员那个级别的绝对怪力。
亚修试着挥动了一下手中的短矛。
“呼——！”
沉重的矛身撕裂空气，发出一声令人心颤的尖啸。
原本还需要双手协同发力才能挥洒自如的长兵器，此刻单手握持竟轻若无物。
一种名为“膨胀”的错觉在血管里激荡。
亚修甚至觉得。
“一力降十会。”
亚修握拳，指节发白。
相比于常人多出近80%的力量，在这冷兵器搏杀中，就是绝对的真理。
要是现在让他回到最初那个夜晚，哪怕赤手空拳，他也敢把那三个腐尸鬼按在地上锤爆。
升级带来的不仅是力量。
刚才战斗积累的些许疲惫也被一扫而空，取而代之的是一种想要找点更硬的东西碰一碰的亢奋。
“还有吗？”
亚修环视四周，短矛轻轻敲击着盾牌边缘，发出挑衅的“笃笃”声。
然而，回应他的只有死一般的寂静。
那股诱饵的腐臭味还在飘散，但迷雾深处却再无动静。
content_en:
Four wights, twenty experience points.
Ash stood on the edge of the dead forest with his short spear in hand, breathing steadily, looking at the blue light curtain that slowly dissipated in his field of vision.
Although the wight looks ferocious.
But with the blessing of equipment and skills, it is much easier to kill than the flexible and swarming giant rats, and the experience value is much richer.
"The only drawback is that I'm poor."
He rummaged through the four corpses for a long time and only found two crystal fragments the size of fingernails.
Ash stood up and his eyes fell on the flashing [Free Attribute Point].
He pondered for a moment, his eyes passed over "Physique" and "Agility", and finally clicked on "Strength" again without hesitation.
With leather armor for protection and buckler for blocking, the fault tolerance rate has been greatly improved.
At this stage, the benefits of physical strength and agility are far less intuitive than the ultimate violent output——
Instead of defending and evading, he first smashed the opponent's head!
【Strength: 6→7】
Buzz——
The familiar warmth washed over my body again.
The muscle fibers tremble crazily, tighten and reorganize under the infusion of that force!
Ash clenched his fist.
The air was pinched and exploded between the palms of his fingers, making a crisp sound.
At the hem of the leather armor, the originally flat belly now has clear lines, and the six-pack abdominal muscles are bulging like rocks, containing explosive power.
It's not just a number plus one.
If we talk about 6 points of strength, he is a strong man who has been exercising all year round and can carry a hundred kilograms of cement on the construction site.
Those 7 points of power are...
So the current 7 points is the absolute strength of a professional weightlifter.
Ash tried to wave the short spear in his hand.
"Huh-!"
The heavy spear body tore through the air, emitting a heart-shaking scream.
The long weapon that originally required the coordinated use of both hands to wield it freely is now as light as nothing when held with one hand.
An illusion called "expansion" surges in the veins.
Ash even felt that.
"One force can defeat ten."
Ash clenched his fists, his knuckles turning white.
Compared with ordinary people, he has nearly 80% more strength. In this cold weapon fight, it is the absolute truth.
If he were to go back to that first night now, he would dare to push those three wights to the ground and blast them with his bare hands.
Upgrading brings more than just power.
Some of the fatigue accumulated from the battle just now was swept away, replaced by a kind of excitement that wanted to find something harder to touch.
"Any more?"
Ash looked around, his short spear gently tapping the edge of the shield, making a provocative "tuk-tuk" sound.
However, all he received in response was deathly silence.
The rancid smell of the bait was still wafting away, but there was no movement deep in the mist.
